patterns: Ashtapradhan portfolio matching dominates: Sumant/Dabir = foreign affairs, Sar-i-Naubat = commander, Sachiv = correspondence, Amatya = finance (APPSC asks Dabir, Sar-i-Naubat).

App MCQs are sound but heavier on revenue/military detail and long multi-statement items than the PYQs.
